Electrical Conductivity (EC); season: Winter; standard: 1000 µS/cm; locations: Brandt Bridge, Old River near Middle River, Airport Way, Vernalis
Additional salinity standards exist for municipal and industrial (M&I) uses.

Tier 1.threshold: Avg of Banks & Jones salinity <900 uS/cm for all 12 months per year in 95% of years.

policies.policy_name: SWRCB Water Quality Control Plan Decision D-1641
policies.note: D-1641 salinity objectives are used by water managers as measurements approach legal thresholds.
Reservoir releases may be used to dilute salinity, but are often driven by other mandates such as water temperature or environmental requirements.
Curtailments may be used to address salinity but are legally triggered by lack of water supply (e.g., drought conditions), not salinity alone.
Curtailments based on special permit terms for junior rights holders, typically tied to upstream storage and water availability rather than salinity thresholds.
Other policy responses such as salinity barriers are generally not activated at this tier.
If a drought emergency is declared, SWP/DWR and CVP/USBR may file Temporary Urgency Change Petitions/Orders (TUCP/O) to modify water rights, which implicates D-1641.

Tier 2.threshold: Avg of Banks & Jones salinity 900-1600 uS/cm for >=10 months per year in 95% of years.

policies.policy_name: Observed salinity exceedances under current climate conditions
policies.note: These salinity levels occur sporadically during very dry or extremely dry years.
Salinity levels at this tier are consistent with likely seawater intrusion in the Delta.
Drought emergency declaration becomes likely under these conditions.
Water Code and SWRCB authority allow temporary relaxation of D-1641 salinity standards via TUCP/O during drought emergencies.

Tier 3.threshold: Avg of Banks & Jones salinity >1600 uS/cm for >=2 months in any year, or occurs in >5% of years at either site.

policies.note: Thresholds are currently rare in California water management but may occur under an unknown future climate regime.
Governor-declared extreme drought emergency is expected at this tier.
Structural salinity barriers would almost certainly be deployed to prevent further seawater intrusion.

policies.policy_name: TUCP/O salinity standards relaxation (very extreme drought)
policies.note: Temporary relaxation of salinity standards would likely be approved for very extreme drought conditions.

Tier 4.threshold: Avg of Banks & Jones salinity >2500 uS/cm for >=2 months in any year.

policies.note: Represents an almost unknown water future requiring extreme measures for human survival, as described in emergency water planning literature.
California regions are encouraged to maintain sufficient water storage to last several water years.
Salinity standards would likely be relaxed for multiple consecutive years under emergency authority.

policies.policy_name: State and federal water project operations
policies.note: CVP/SWP operations would likely be limited to food-security-level agriculture and basic human needs under state emergency planning.
Curtailments and salinity barriers initiated in earlier stages would likely remain in place.
